mapper.select: SELECT id, session_id, user_id, round_no, question_text, answer_text, score, result, evaluation, status, answered_time, create_time, update_time FROM interview_turn WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND status = 0 ORDER BY round_no DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE interview_turn SET answer_text = #{answerText}, score = #{score}, result = #{result}, evaluation = #{evaluation}, status = 2, answered_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 0
UPDATE interview_turn SET answer_text = #{answerText}, evaluation = #{evaluation}, status = 3, answered_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 0
UPDATE interview_turn SET status = 4 WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND status = 0
mapper.select: SELECT id, session_id, user_id, round_no, question_text, answer_text, score, result, evaluation, status, answered_time, create_time, update_time FROM interview_turn WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND status IN (2, 3) AND answer_text IS NOT NULL ORDER BY round_no ASC
